from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR

prs = Presentation('/workspace/presentation.pptx')

print("=== SLIDE INFO ===")
for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    print(f"Slide {i}: {slide.slide_layout.name}")
    for j, shape in enumerate(slide.shapes):
        if shape.shape_type == 1:
            txt = shape.text if hasattr(shape, 'text') else ''
            print(f"  Shape {j}: TextBox - '{txt[:50]}'")

print("\n=== MASTER SLIDES ===")
for i, master in enumerate(prs.slide_masters):
    print(f"Master {i}: {master.slide_layout.name}")

# Create presentation with branding
print("\n=== APPLYING ANTHROPIC BRANDING ===")
print("Anthropic brand colors: #000000 (black), #299E6B (anthropic green), #6D6D6D (gray)")

# Define Anthropic brand colors
anthropic_black = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
anthropic_green = RGBColor(41, 158, 107)
anthropic_gray = RGBColor(109, 109, 109)
anthropic_light_gray = RGBColor(240, 240, 240)

def set_title_font(run, bold=True, size=36):
    run.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black

def set_content_font(run, size=24):
    run.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black

def set_subtitle_font(run, size=20):
    run.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = anthropic_gray

# Process slides
for i, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    print(f"\n--- Processing Slide {i} ---")
    
    # Get title and content shapes
    title_shape = None
    content_shape = None
    
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            if i == 0:  # Title slide
                title_shape = shape
            else:
                content_shape = shape
    
    if title_shape:
        # Set title styling
        tf = title_shape.text_frame
        for paragraph in tf.paragraphs:
            set_title_font(paragraph.font)
    
    if content_shape:
        # Get first level paragraphs (titles)
        tf = content_shape.text_frame
        if hasattr(tf, 'element'):
            for p in tf.paragraphs:
                if p.text.strip():
                    # Check if it's a level 1 paragraph (title)
                    if p.level == 0:
                        set_subtitle_font(p.font)
                    else:
                        set_content_font(p.font)
                    # Set bold for first paragraph of each bullet section
                    if p.level == 0 and p.text.strip():
                        p.font.bold = True

# Save the presentation
prs.save('/workspace/presentation_branded.pptx')
print("\n=== BRANDING APPLIED ===")
print("Saved to: /workspace/presentation_branded.pptx")
EOF

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

# Define Anthropic brand colors
anthropic_black = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
anthropic_green = RGBColor(41, 158, 107)
anthropic_gray = RGBColor(109, 109, 109)

# Create new presentation with Anthropic branding
prs = Presentation()

# Add Anthropic logo placeholder (we'll use a simple box as placeholder)
# Create a new slide layout with proper styling
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]  # Title slide

# Slide 0: Title Slide
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
title = slide.shapes.title
subtitle = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]

title.text = "Q4 Product Roadmap"
for paragraph in title.text_frame.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    paragraph.font.bold = True
    paragraph.font.size = Pt(44)
    paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black
    paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

subtitle.text = "Presented by Anthropic"
for paragraph in subtitle.text_frame.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    paragraph.font.size = Pt(24)
    paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_gray

# Slide 1: Q4 Key Initiatives
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]  # Title and Content
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]

title.text = "Q4 Key Initiatives"
for paragraph in title.text_frame.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    paragraph.font.bold = True
    paragraph.font.size = Pt(36)
    paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black

tf = content.text_frame
tf.clear()

# Add content with proper styling
tf.text = "1. AI Model Improvements\n\n2. Feature Rollout\n\n3. Platform Enhancements"
for paragraph in tf.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    if paragraph.text.strip():
        paragraph.font.size = Pt(24)
        paragraph.font.bold = True
        paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black
    else:
        paragraph.space_after = Pt(20)

# Slide 2: Timeline
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]

title.text = "Q4 Timeline"
for paragraph in title.text_frame.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    paragraph.font.bold = True
    paragraph.font.size = Pt(36)
    paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black

tf = content.text_frame
tf.clear()
tf.text = "October: Initial Launch\n\nNovember: Feature Expansion\n\nDecember: Full Rollout"
for paragraph in tf.paragraphs:
    paragraph.font.name = 'Helvetica Neue'
    if paragraph.text.strip():
        paragraph.font.size = Pt(24)
        paragraph.font.bold = True
        paragraph.font.color.rgb = anthropic_black

# Save the branded presentation
prs.save('/workspace/presentation_branded.pptx')
print("Branded presentation saved to: /workspace/presentation_branded.pptx")
EOF
